description:
Dask runs fail on all 22 TPC-H queries due to API incompatibilities between
Dask and Pandas. The root cause is that pandas_impl query functions call
.groupby(as_index=False) directly, which Dask doesn't support.

Errors by category:
- as_index=False not supported: Q1-Q5, Q10-Q13, Q15-Q18, Q20, Q22 (16 queries)
- .dt.year on DatetimeIndex: Q7, Q8, Q9 (3 queries)
- nunique aggregate: Q16, Q21 (2 queries)
- Lazy scalar conversion: Q6, Q14, Q19 (3 queries)

Solution: Created UnifiedPandasFrame wrapper (following Expression family pattern)
that intercepts DataFrame operations and routes to adapter for platform-specific
handling. Also made minor query adaptations to handle lazy scalar computations.
